newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ONE REPO DEAL STRUCK ON BULGARIA EXCHANGES.
newsitem.headline: ONE REPO DEAL STRUCK ON BULGARIA EXCHANGES.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Tuesday's 41.28 points as no corporate issues traded on Bulgarian stock exchanges for an eight day in row, brokers said.
One seven-day repo deal in treasury paper worth of 6.0 million levs was struck on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE).
The paper yields 4.94 percent until repurchase.
Vrana Grand Hotel shares were offered at par of 100 levs and were bid at 80 levs but there were no deals.
Several state-owned banks' shares were offered on the BSE but there were no buyers.
